QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_2

question.text: The Social Stock Exchange (SSE) concept was first introduced globally in which country, and which is the ORIGINAL launch year referenced in the SIA workbook?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 2, the first Social Stock Exchange was introduced and launched in Brazil in 2003 (Brazil's BVSA — Socio-Environmental Impact Exchange). South Africa (2006), Portugal (2009), Canada/Singapore/UK (2013) and Jamaica (2019) followed. Of the seven originally set up, only Canada, Singapore and Jamaica still function. The Trap: UK, Singapore and Canada each launched in 2013, which tempts the reader because the year is correct but the country is wrong. The trap is memorising 'year' rather than 'first-mover'.
